_meta.purpose: Canonical bilingual strings for Phukumhom Resort Khao Yai. Copy from here; do not retype or re-translate. Wording rules and reasoning are in docs/VOICE.md. Facts (address, phone, times, URLs) are NOT stored here: they live in src/content and are interpolated.
conventions: Every leaf is {en, th} except rooms.*.name (a proper name, identical in both languages) and keys beginning with an underscore (notes, never rendered).
Placeholders use {curlyNames}. The values come from src/content; never hard-code a fact into a string.
English labels and buttons are sentence case. Terms meant for running copy are lower case.
Thai strings carry no full stop, no polite particles and no letter-spacing. The repetition mark is attached to the word before it and followed by a space.
Dates are Gregorian in both languages: 7 October 2026 / 7 ตุลาคม 2026 (short: 7 Oct 2026 / 7 ต.ค. 2026). Times are 24-hour: 14:00 in English, 14:00 น. in Thai.
In Thai, the three room names stay in Latin script and follow the classifier: ห้อง Deluxe Balcony.
